title: Yanming41 dsh plugins
description: Discord bridge, persistent Claude Code / Codex sessions, secret vault, secret guard

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-discord-bridge
plugins.title: dsh-plugin-discord-bridge
plugins.description: Discord bridge for DeepSeek Harness: chat with dsh / Claude Code / Codex in Discord threads, one bot per agent with @ routing, per-thread work lock and queue, live progress, reply buttons, LaTeX rendering, and opening/resuming local sessions from Discord.
plugins.author: Yanming41

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-persistent-agents
plugins.title: dsh-plugin-persistent-agents
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 插件：常驻的 Claude Code / Codex 会话（CC 走 stream-json + stdio 权限，Codex 走 app-server），支持续接、人工审批和中断
plugins.author: Yanming41

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-secret-guard
plugins.title: dsh-plugin-secret-guard
plugins.description: Secret leak guard for DeepSeek Harness: scrubs secrets before they reach the session log, the model context, the system prompt, telemetry, and outbound messages. Pairs with secret-vault to catch your own stored passwords exactly.
plugins.author: Yanming41

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-secret-vault
plugins.title: dsh-plugin-secret-vault
plugins.description: Encrypted secret vault for DeepSeek Harness: the model uses secrets by reference and never sees the values; one-time links let you enter secrets from phone/Mac.
plugins.author: Yanming41
